description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber' which acts as an event subscriber within the OrangHRM Buzz plugin. It listens to specific events related to employee deletion and purging to adjust like and comment counts on shares and comments in the Buzz feature.
external_files: OrangeHRM	axim	ext	event uild ase	ype uild ase	ype	est-related.php

classes.name: BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that listens for specific maintenance and employee deletion events to update like and comment counts in the Buzz module.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping events to handler methods, enabling the class to respond to employee purging and deletion events.

methods.name: onEmployeePurgingEnd
methods.description: Handles the 'PurgeEmployee' event; triggers updates to decrease like and comment counts related to the purged employee.

methods.name: onEmployeesDeleted
methods.description: Handles the 'EmployeeDeletedEvent' event; triggers updates to decrease like and comment counts for deleted employees.
